reason: Saturdays are my kid time and a clean, calm place where I can actually sit with a coffee beats a germy loud play place. I'd use the free visit and probably pay for one or two weekend visits, not a membership.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and I only get weekends, so $15 plus gas for a Saturday outing has to beat the free library and park.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price nearer $10-12, or a pack I can use on Saturdays that brings the per-visit cost down.
